Tools (ds.tl)#

Functions for training, inference, perturbation simulation, and GRN extraction.

Training#

deepscenic.tl.train(mdata, epochs=100, warmup_vae=10, warmup_grn=50, batch_size=64, seq_batch_size=1000, lr=0.001, device='cuda', logger='dict', log_dir='./runs', checkpoint_dir=None, checkpoint_every=10, resume_from=None, early_stopping_patience=None, balance_dars=False, num_workers=0, bed_file=None, fasta_file=None, **kwargs)[source]#

Train deepSCENIC model on multiome data.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData with preprocessed RNA + ATAC data

  • epochs (int) – Total training epochs

  • warmup_vae (int) – Epochs before enabling TF2rNet

  • warmup_grn (int) – Epochs before enabling PPI

  • batch_size (int) – Cells per batch

  • seq_batch_size (int) – Sequences per batch

  • lr (float) – Base learning rate

  • device (str) – Training device

  • logger (str) – Logging backend: ‘dict’, ‘tensorboard’, ‘wandb’

  • log_dir (str) – Directory for tensorboard/wandb logs

  • checkpoint_dir (str | None) – Directory for checkpoints (None = no checkpoints)

  • checkpoint_every (int) – Save checkpoint every N epochs

  • resume_from (str | None) – Path to checkpoint to resume from

  • early_stopping_patience (int | None) – Stop if no improvement for N epochs (None = disabled)

  • balance_dars (bool) – Whether to upweight DAR regions during sequence sampling (1.5x weight). Requires DARs to be marked via ds.pp.mark_dars() first.

  • num_workers (int) – Number of workers for parallel data loading (0 = main process only)

  • bed_file (str | None) – Path to BED file with region coordinates

  • fasta_file (str | None) – Path to genome FASTA file

  • **kwargs (Any) – Additional config options (ppi_device, etc.)

Returns:

Trained model (self-contained, ready for inference)

Return type:

DeepSCENICModel

Model#

class deepscenic.tl.DeepSCENICModel(vae, tf2rnet, enformer, adj_E1, config, tf_names, gene_names, region_names)[source]#

Trained deepSCENIC model container.

This is the object returned by ds.tl.train() and loaded by ds.tl.load_model(). Contains all trained components and metadata for self-contained inference.

Parameters:

  • vae (DeepSCENICVAE)

  • tf2rnet (MotifNet)

  • enformer (nn.Module)

  • adj_E1 (torch.Tensor)

  • config (TrainingConfig)

  • tf_names (list[str])

  • gene_names (list[str])

  • region_names (list[str])

vae#

Trained VAE model

Type:

DeepSCENICVAE

tf2rnet#

Trained TF2rNet context head

Type:

MotifNet

enformer#

Fine-tuned Enformer model

Type:

nn.Module

adj_E1#

Cached E1 matrix (n_regions, n_tfs)

Type:

Tensor

config#

Training configuration used

Type:

TrainingConfig

tf_names#

TF names in order

Type:

list[str]

gene_names#

Gene names in order

Type:

list[str]

region_names#

Region names in order

Type:

list[str]

Examples

>>> model = ds.tl.train(mdata, epochs=100)
>>> model.save("model.pt")
>>> loaded = ds.tl.load_model("model.pt")
>>> embeddings = ds.tl.to_latent(loaded, mdata)
deepscenic.tl.load_model(path, device='cpu')[source]#

Load a trained deepSCENIC model.

Parameters:

  • path (str | Path) – Path to saved model file (.pt)

  • device (str) – Device to load model to

Returns:

Loaded model ready for inference

Return type:

DeepSCENICModel

Inference#

deepscenic.tl.to_latent(model, mdata, batch_size=256, device=None, split=None)[source]#

Extract embeddings from trained model.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData with RNA + ATAC data

  • batch_size (int) – Cells per batch for inference

  • device (str | None) – Device for inference (None = use model’s current device)

  • split (str | None) – If specified, only process cells from this split (‘train’ or ‘test’)

Returns:

Dictionary with embeddings: - ‘z_tf’: TF latent activity (n_cells, n_tfs) - ‘enh_act’: Region activity (n_cells, n_regions) - ‘z_rna’: Gene regulatory signal (n_cells, n_genes) - ‘x_rna_rec’: Reconstructed RNA (n_cells, n_genes) - ‘x_atac_rec’: Reconstructed ATAC (n_cells, n_regions) - ‘x_rna_ppi’: PPI modulation weights (n_cells, n_tfs)

Return type:

dict[str, np.ndarray]

Examples

>>> model = ds.tl.load_model("model.pt")
>>> embeddings = ds.tl.to_latent(model, mdata)
>>> z_tf = embeddings['z_tf']  # (n_cells, n_tfs)

Perturbation Simulation#

deepscenic.tl.simulate_perturbation(model, mdata, tf_name, level=0.0, n_iter=10, batch_size=256, device=None, split=None)[source]#

Simulate TF knockdown/overexpression.

Perturbs a TF’s expression and iteratively propagates the effect through the GRN to predict gene expression changes.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData with RNA + ATAC data

  • tf_name (str) – Name of TF to perturb (e.g., ‘SOX10’)

  • level (float) – Perturbation level (0 = knockout, >0 = overexpression)

  • n_iter (int) – Iterations to reach steady state

  • batch_size (int) – Cells per batch for inference

  • device (str | None) – Device for computation

  • split (str | None) – If specified, only process cells from this split

Returns:

Log fold change predictions (n_cells, n_genes)

Return type:

np.ndarray

Examples

>>> model = ds.tl.load_model("model.pt")
>>> logFC = ds.tl.simulate_perturbation(model, mdata, tf_name="SOX10", level=0)
>>> # logFC contains predicted expression changes for all genes
deepscenic.tl.simulate_multi_perturbation(model, mdata, tf_names, levels=None, n_iter=10, batch_size=256, device=None, split=None)[source]#

Simulate simultaneous perturbation of multiple TFs.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • mdata (MuData) – MuData with RNA + ATAC data

  • tf_names (list[str]) – List of TF names to perturb

  • levels (list[float] | None) – Perturbation levels for each TF (default: all 0 = knockout)

  • n_iter (int) – Iterations to reach steady state

  • batch_size (int) – Cells per batch for inference

  • device (str | None) – Device for computation

  • split (str | None) – If specified, only process cells from this split

Returns:

Log fold change predictions (n_cells, n_genes)

Return type:

np.ndarray

GRN Extraction#

deepscenic.tl.extract_grn(model)[source]#

Extract GRN matrices as DataFrames with names.

Parameters:

model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

Returns:

Dictionary with: - ‘E1’: DataFrame (n_regions, n_tfs) with region/TF names - ‘E2’: DataFrame (sparse format) with region/gene links

Return type:

dict[str, pd.DataFrame]

Examples

>>> model = ds.tl.load_model("model.pt")
>>> grn = ds.tl.extract_grn(model)
>>> E1 = grn['E1']  # TF → region weights
>>> E2 = grn['E2']  # region → gene weights
deepscenic.tl.extract_e1_matrix(model)[source]#

Extract E1 (TF→region) matrix as DataFrame.

Parameters:

model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

Returns:

E1 matrix (n_regions, n_tfs) with region/TF names

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

deepscenic.tl.extract_e2_matrix(model, as_sparse=True)[source]#

Extract E2 (region→gene) matrix.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • as_sparse (bool) – If True, return sparse format (region, gene, weight). If False, return dense DataFrame.

Returns:

E2 matrix in sparse or dense format

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

deepscenic.tl.get_tf_targets(model, tf_name, threshold=0.0, top_k=None)[source]#

Get target regions and genes for a specific TF.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • tf_name (str) – Name of the TF

  • threshold (float) – Minimum weight threshold

  • top_k (int | None) – If specified, return only top K targets

Returns:

DataFrame with columns: region, E1_weight, gene, E2_weight, combined_weight

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

deepscenic.tl.get_gene_regulators(model, gene_name, threshold=0.0, top_k=None)[source]#

Get TFs and regions that regulate a specific gene.

Parameters:

  • model (DeepSCENICModel) – Trained DeepSCENICModel

  • gene_name (str) – Name of the gene

  • threshold (float) – Minimum weight threshold

  • top_k (int | None) – If specified, return only top K regulators

Returns:

DataFrame with columns: tf, region, E1_weight, E2_weight, combined_weight

Return type:

pd.DataFrame
